description: This file defines an interface for a mutable builder of 'Feature' objects, providing API methods for setting, retrieving, removing features, and building an immutable Features object. The interface supports fluent method chaining and is annotated as not thread-safe.

classes.name: FeaturesBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder interface for constructing 'Features' objects with a fluent API, supporting setting, retrieving, removing features, and building immutable collections.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or replaces a Feature in the builder with the given Feature object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a Feature by its ID, returning an Optional to account for absence.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Replaces all current features with the provided iterable of features.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specific Feature object from the builder.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a Feature identified by its ID.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all features from the builder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates an immutable Features object containing the accumulated features.
